sources.title: Kolibri 1 official model card, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact Kolibri-1 FP8 release card; identifies name, developer, exact counts, text modalities, release date, license and capabilities. Pinned README retrieved successfully.

sources.title: Kolibri-1 configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Kolibri1ForCausalLM; 50 layers, 384 experts, six selected per token, shared expert, 4:1 sliding/full attention; max_position_embeddings 262144; FP8 quantization.

sources.title: Kolibri Has Landed: A Sovereign Open-Weight Model
sources.evidence: Dated 3 October 2026; announces release and downloadable Apache-2.0 weights. Names Kolibri and earlier Kolibri Origin; describes a German-English MoE transformer.

sources.title: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
sources.evidence: Abstract and Table 2 identify 78.1B total and 3.46B active. Table 2 explicitly excludes embeddings from active counts and lists six routed plus one shared expert per token.

sources.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri
sources.evidence: 5 October announcement explicitly says available since 3 October; confirms RAG, native tool use, adjustable reasoning and bilingual support.

sources.title: Hugging Face repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current revision 5bb7075ba22db733e3834b1c71d2245537cc14ed. Safetensors metadata totals 78,103,074,560 parameters. Repository creation on October 2 is not the October 3 public release date.

developer.note: Brand retained; legal developer is Aleph Alpha Research GmbH, provider Aleph Alpha GmbH.

family.note: Normalized Kolibri lineage name; report relates it to Kolibri Origin.

release_date.note: Explicit public-release date; October 5 is the later news publication.

open_weights.note: Official announcement provides downloadable full weights.

license.note: Card scopes grant to repository weights and configuration files.

parameters_b.note: 78,103,074,560 parameters divided by 1e9; exact published count, not nominal 78B.

active_parameters_b.note: 3,457,573,120 per token divided by 1e9. Technical report excludes embeddings; rounded to 3.46B.

architecture.note: Transformer with six of 384 routed experts and one shared expert per layer; 50 layers with hybrid sliding/full GQA attention.

context_window.note: Maximum validated extrapolated context. Native and default configuration: 262,144 tokens; larger serving requires overrides.

modalities.note: Intended-use section explicitly specifies text input and output.

description.value: Aleph Alpha's German and English mixture-of-experts reasoning model (78B total, 3.46B active) for chat, RAG and agents
description.note: Supported; parameter shorthand is rounded, and intended RAG/assistant/agent use is documented.

patch.notes: Active parameter count excludes embeddings. Context is 262,144 tokens natively and 1,048,576 by validated extrapolation; serving beyond 262,144 requires configuration overrides. This repository is the FP8 Kolibri-1 release. Apache-2.0 applies to the published weights and configuration files.

summary: Fill missing total/active counts from exact developer disclosure, MoE architecture and Kolibri family. All existing factual values are supported. Retain 1,048,576 as the maximum context with native/default-context qualification. The announcement rounds active parameters to 3B; the card/report provide greater precision, not a conflicting model size.
